company.name: PalletPal
company.shortDescription: PalletPal is a logistics technology company that provides a digital freight forwarding and supply-chain management platform.
company.description:
PalletPal is a logistics technology company that provides a digital freight forwarding and supply-chain management platform for businesses moving cargo to and from the Middle East and North Africa (MENA).
PalletPal operates an online platform that allows companies to book, compare, and manage international freight shipments through a network of logistics providers. The platform supports transportation by sea, air, and road, helping businesses coordinate cross-border cargo movements using a centralized digital system.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $200,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,163,506 to $2,163,506, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 67 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 36 (-6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
